caseFormat.body: JSON object, or formData descriptor for multipart requests
caseFormat.expected: HTTP status and observable response/database behavior documented for the API
caseFormat.executionNote: Cases needing email inbox access, concurrent requests, file fixtures, or persisted state identify those preconditions explicitly. Capture tokens only in local test variables; never log or commit them.
